color.$description: Semantic color roles, light theme. Components use these, never the palette.

$root.$description: Brand green: primary buttons, active navigation, selected controls and link icons.

container.$description: Soft accent background: drop placeholders, the slot a card lands in while the overview is edited.

tonal.$description: Tonal fill for the selected item in navigation and segmented controls.

inverse.$description: Accent on inverse surfaces, such as the action in a toast.

accent.$description: Text and icons on the accent fill.

accent-tonal.$description: Text and icons on the tonal accent fill.

emphasis.$description: Text on saturated fills (accent or danger) that stays white in both themes, such as badges.

$root.$description: Delays, overdue items, alerts and destructive actions: fills, icons and chart marks.

solid.$description: Danger fill that carries text, such as notification badges: white on it reaches 4.5:1 in both themes.

$root.$description: Pending and on-hold states: dots and icons.

text.$description: Emphasis levels, defined by contrast so both themes read alike. Every level meant to be read passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface, containers included. Disabled is exempt in WCAG, and is kept at 3:1 so it can still be read.

secondary.$description: Navigation at rest, secondary text and icons.

muted.$description: Body text one step quieter than default, such as the reading of a search.

tertiary.$description: Placeholders, hints and inactive legend entries: the faintest text, still 4.5:1.

meta.$description: Metadata and small labels: dates, units, supporting figures. The same as tertiary in light, where the product’s own gray falls below 4.5:1; quieter than tertiary in dark.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text in fields. Placeholders are text, so they read at the tertiary level; a role of its own lets fields change it without touching tertiary.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. Exempt from contrast in WCAG; the control keeps its outline or shape so it still reads as present.

inverse.$description: Text on inverse surfaces: tooltips, toasts.

raised.$description: Top bar and small raised controls.

container.$description: Segmented tracks, neutral notices and chips.

well-hover.$description: Hover on a control drawn on the well, such as New order in the Orders card (v38 .addbtn:hover). Since 1.1.

selected.$description: Row whose detail panel is open.

search-head.$description: Head row of search results: the status line (“Smart search · …”). Since 1.1.

search-active.$description: The highlighted search result, the one Enter chooses. Since 1.1.

scrim.$description: Veil behind modal sheets and drawers.

emphasis.$description: Dotted connectors, pending route segments, hover borders.

control.$description: Boundaries of fields, checkboxes and switches. At least 3:1 on card (WCAG 1.4.11).

muted.$description: Inactive segments of bars and progress.

hover.$description: State layer for hover on icon buttons and list items.

pressed.$description: State layer for pressed and active.

on-accent-hover.$description: State layer for hover on accent fills.

on-accent-pressed.$description: State layer for pressed on accent fills.

alert.$description: Values that need attention, such as stock on hold.

rest.$description: Remainder of a whole: the rest of a donut or bar.

tip-shadow.$description: The chart bubble’s drop shadow; none in dark, where the bubble is light.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. At least 3:1 on every surface (WCAG 2.4.13).
